Four words that sort almost every business I talk to.

Is the phone ringing?

If it rings and you're losing people — voicemail, the 9 PM message that waits till morning, follow-up that depends on somebody remembering — you don't have a marketing problem. You have a leak. And a leak is the cheap fix.

If it doesn't ring enough, that isn't a leak. There's nothing to catch yet. Something has to get built first.

Most businesses buy the wrong one. They spend on ads while losing half the calls they already get — or install automation into a room where the phone isn't ringing.

Same money. Wrong problem.

Two minutes will tell you which one you are: signaturebrandmarketing.com/assessment

#smallbusiness #marketing #winterhaven #businessgrowth

A brand over here. A website over there. A CRM nobody updates. Follow-up that depends on somebody remembering.

Every one of those is fine on its own.

Together they're a business that only runs when you're standing in the middle of it.

That's why the ads didn't work. Not because the ad was bad — because the thing on the other side of the click wasn't ready.

Most businesses don't have a marketing problem. They have a systems problem.

A marketing problem you fix with a better ad. A systems problem you fix by building the thing that catches what the ad sends.
